tp:simple-type.name: Timestamp
tp:simple-type.tp:docstring: A 64-bit signed integer representing time in microseconds since the base::Time Epoch. Use base::Time::FromInternalValue to reconstitute.

tp:simple-type.name: Bytes
tp:simple-type.tp:docstring: A 64-bit signed integer representing a byte count.

tp:simple-type.name: BytesPerItem
tp:simple-type.tp:docstring: An array of String(User)-Integer(Bytes) pairs. We use this structure when mapping users to bytes.

tp:struct.name: DataPlan
tp:struct.tp:docstring: A struct representing a data plan for a cellular service. Some fields are not always present, so this is sent as a dict.

tp:member.name: CellularPlanType
tp:member.tp:docstring: Plan type. One of: UNLIMITED, METERED_PAID, METERED_BASE.

tp:member.name: CellularPlanUpdateTime
tp:member.tp:docstring: Timestamp indicating freshness of plan data.

tp:member.name: CellularPlanStart
tp:member.tp:docstring: Timestamp indicating time at which plan becomes active.

tp:member.name: CellularPlanEnd
tp:member.tp:docstring: Timestamp indicating time at which plan expires.

tp:member.name: CellularPlanDataBytes
tp:member.tp:docstring: Max number of bytes available during plan period.

tp:member.name: CellularDataBytesUsed
tp:member.tp:docstring: Number of bytes already consumed during plan period.

signal.name: DataPlansUpdate
signal.tp:docstring: Update containing data plan info for a cellular service.

arg.name: service
arg.tp:docstring: The dbus path of the cellular service to which this update pertains.

arg.name: plans
arg.tp:docstring: A list of plan structs describing the data plans for |service|.

method.name: GetDataPlans
method.tp:docstring: Get data plan info for a cellular service.

arg.name: service
arg.tp:docstring: The dbus path of the cellular service for which caller wants info.

arg.name: plans
arg.tp:docstring: A list of plan structs describing the data plans for |service|.

tp:possible-errors.tp:error: The service path does not correspond to a known service.

method.name: RequestDataPlansUpdate
method.tp:docstring: Request that a DataPlansUpdate signal be sent for a cellular service.

arg.name: service
arg.tp:docstring: The dbus path of the cellular service for which caller wants info.

tp:possible-errors.tp:error: The service path does not correspond to a known service.

arg.name: usage
arg.tp:docstring: Structure that maps dates to usage (in bytes)

method.name: IsAlive
method.tp:docstring: Test method to verify that Cashew service is working.

arg.name: result
arg.tp:docstring: Boolean indicating whether Cashew service is alive.
